name: m4-bti-cfp
description: Spikes from the `baseTypeIndex` review on `SymbolOpsBenchmark`'s `subtype` workload, against retronym/scala#208: a Bloom filter that answers most `baseTypeIndex` misses, a `firstTry` fast path that decides `<:<` against a top-level monomorphic class by base type sequence membership, and both. Three forks each, after one-fork spikes on m5-pro (`m5-bti-spikes`) put each at about 4-5%, inside that machine's noise.

variantDescriptions.mask: `pr208` + a 64-bit Bloom filter of each sequence's symbol ids, checked before the scan (`claude/bti-mask`)
variantDescriptions.cfp: `pr208` + `firstTry` answering hits against a top-level monomorphic class from `sym1`'s base type sequence, skipping `baseType`, `relativize` and the recursive `isSubType` (`claude/subtype-class-fastpath`)
